notes.rw: Reweighting keeps each recall group's vote and resets the Trump, Harris and other shares to the 2024 result. Only Senate polls with usable recall crosstabs can be reweighted; polls already weighted to 2024 vote keep their published numbers. Governor: no poll was reweighted, so this filter shows only polls already weighted to 2024 vote.
notes.xt: Crosstab status comes from the polls whose releases we opened. A poll we have not checked counts as "not checked" and drops out of the crosstab filter; so do paywalled crosstabs.
notes.links: Each pollster name links to the release Wikipedia cites. Grade R: topline taken from Wikipedia, release not opened; grade V: release opened. Toplines use the question each source lists first: with leaners where the pollster publishes them (for example Verasight, Big Data Poll, Overton and Emerson's Senate question), the initial ask otherwise (Emerson's Governor question).
notes.nofake: This filter removes every SoCal and Wedgewood Texas poll. Wedgewood admitted fabricating its polls. SoCal admitted nothing: FiftyPlusOne disputes some, not all, of its polls and kept the older ones, and Lester Tellez says the 2024 SoCal polls he paid for were real.
notes.error: Poll lists are each race's Wikipedia table (the 2024 table omits the October 2024 UT/TPP poll that RCP lists). RCP's final averages missed by different amounts: 2022 Governor 0.5 too Democratic against this chart's 3.1; 2020 President 4.5 against 4.1.
